sentences.text:
Palash Bhattacharyya & Ors vs State Of West Bengal & Anr on 9
July, 2025

Author: Jay Sengupta
Bench: Jay Sengupta
D/L - 445
09/07/2025
Court No.28
S.Kundu
 Crr 1701 of 2025
 Palash Bhattacharyya & Ors.
 Vs.
 State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Sunny Nandy
 Ms. Riya Das
 Ms. Yamini Tiwari
 ...for the petitioners.

1.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits as follows.
The petitioners are the brother-in-law, the sister-in-law and the aunt-in-law of the de-facto complainant/wife.
The husband is not before this Court.
A charge-sheet was submitted under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code against the petitioners and the husband of the de-facto complainant in 2020.
During the pendency of this application, charges have been framed and the next date of hearing before the Trial Court is in October, 2025.
No prima facie case is made out against the petitioners and any further continuation of the impugned proceeding shall be an abuse of the process of the law.

2. Let the petitioners serve a copy of the application upon the State through the learned Public Prosecutor and upon the opposite party no. 2 by speed post with AD within a week and file affidavit of service to that effect on the next date.
3.
List this matter for hearing as a Contested Application after five weeks hence.
4. The impugned proceeding shall remain stayed so far as the present petitioners are concerned for a period of seven weeks.
